purpose: Attempt at the reusable motion base. Generated ONCE per presenter and reused across all 32 of Curtis's courses and every application video he presents.

input.prompt: Professional man seated at his desk in the approved modern corporate-office composition, holding still between takes. He is NOT speaking. His mouth stays completely closed and completely motionless for the entire clip: lips pressed together at every frame, no lip separation, no gap between the lips, no teeth ever visible, no mouth opening, no jaw movement. He holds the exact same closed-lip expression as the source image from the first frame to the last, with no change of expression and no change of smile. Natural irregular blinking approximately every 3-4 seconds. Only very subtle breathing and tiny natural head/posture settling. No deliberate head turns, nodding, leaning, gestures, or expressive movement. His hands remain exactly as shown in the source image, fingers interlocked and completely still on the desk. The camera is locked off on a tripod at a fixed focal length and a fixed distance. There is no push-in, no zoom, no dolly, no change of camera distance and no change of subject scale at ANY point in the clip, including the final second. The crop, scale, camera distance and framing of the LAST frame are identical to the FIRST frame: the mug at camera-left, the shelf, the wall screen and the window all stay in frame at exactly the same size and position throughout. No pan, tilt, drift, parallax, reframing, or crop change. Preserve Curtis's face, beard, hair, wardrobe, skin tone, proportions, lighting, contrast, color, shadows, office environment, desk objects, and approved composition exactly as shown. Preserve all existing visible lettering and branding on the wall screen, mug, books, and set elements without alteration. One continuous 5-second shot with no cuts, transitions, scene changes, added graphics, captions, logos, or new elements. The result should look like the approved Curtis still naturally coming alive while remaining almost completely motionless.
